title: Nomi AI Sensei Curriculum Gate & Strict Cumulative Pedagogical Lattice Guard
objective: Harden Nomi Sensei AI dialogue across frontend and backend to strictly enforce the Cumulative Pedagogical Lattice (Law 2 & Law 6). Ensure no untaught characters, raw Kanji, or out-of-order vocabulary are presented to early learners without prerequisite unlock or explicit scaffolding. Connect LearnerKnowledgeState directly into AI endpoints, enforce server-side and client-side lattice audits with assertSenseiOutputEligible, and guarantee compassionate Bengali mistake recovery (Law 5) across all learning domains.
in_scope: Connect LearnerKnowledgeState prerequisites into /api/ai/coach and /api/ai/sentence-dna request pipelines.
Enforce assertSenseiOutputEligible on model outputs, sanitizing untaught kana/kanji with furigana/romaji and Bengali guidance for early learners.
Harden generateSenseiOfflineResponse to respect the learner's unlocked vowel and syllable lattice.
Reinforce SenseiLoopBridge mistake recovery with targeted micro-coaching across all four learning domains.
Create automated verification test suite scripts/test-nomi-ai-sensei-lattice.ts testing early vowel stage, intermediate stage, and mistake recovery.
Verify with npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build.
out_of_scope: Modifying subscription tier pricing, Stripe/bKash webhooks, or database schemas.
Changing POS simulation inventory items or JIS resume PDF layout.
acceptance_criteria: Early learner (knowing only あ) asking Sensei a question never receives raw untaught Kanji or out-of-order characters without clear pedagogical scaffolding.
Model outputs that contain unauthorized characters are intercepted, sanitized, and accompanied by helpful Bengali sensei notes.
Offline Sensei fallback responses respect the learner's knowledge stage.
SenseiLoopBridge mistake recovery micro-coaching is compassionate, encouraging, and adheres to Dignified Mistake Recovery (Law 5).
Automated verification test script scripts/test-nomi-ai-sensei-lattice.ts passes 100% of assertions.
Zero TypeScript errors (npx tsc --noEmit) and clean production build (npm run build).
verification: npm run build finishes with 0 errors.
risks: LLM non-determinism introducing unexpected kana (mitigated by strict post-generation lattice filter assertSenseiOutputEligible).
